findings.fix: State all four under [Field K] [ValuativeRel K] [IsDiscreteValuationRing (valuation K).integer], keeping topology and local-field assumptions for the topological and measure results.

summary: Four algebraic results still require unnecessary local-field assumptions, excluding general discretely valued fields.
